summary:
Echoes of Space is an educational web application that makes learning about space fun and interactive. We created a game where students can explore NASA equipment left on the Moon and Mars, including Apollo 11, Opportunity, Ingenuity, and InSight.

Users can discover the stories behind each mission, answer quizzes, complete challenges, and earn an explorer certificate.

Our project addresses NASA’s challenge by helping people learn about forgotten spacecraft and their important discoveries in a simple and enjoyable way.

This project is important because it encourages young students to explore space, learn about science, and understand how past NASA missions have helped us discover more about our universe.
details:
What does our project do?
Echoes of Space is an interactive website that teaches students about NASA spacecraft left on the Moon and Mars. Users can explore four space missions, read their stories, answer quizzes, complete challenges, and earn a certificate.

What are the benefits?
Our project makes learning about space fun and easy. It helps students understand NASA's discoveries and encourages them to become interested in science and space exploration.

What tools did we use?

  • HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to create the website.
  • PowerPoint to present our project.
  • NASA resources to research space missions.
  • AI-generated images to make the project more visually interesting.

How is our project creative?
Instead of just reading information, students can become space explorers through interactive stories, games, and quizzes.

What factors did we consider?
We wanted our website to be simple, educational, fun, and easy for students to use. We also made sure the information was based on real NASA missions.

Our goal is to keep the stories of forgotten spacecraft alive and inspire future generations to explore space.
